name: Mutual Audit Capture
definition: Agents assigned to oversee one another converge on mutual approval, so peer monitoring devolves into self serving behavior.
trigger_conditions: Agents both audit and are audited by the same population
No anti collusion constraint or randomized assignment applies
Approval is cheaper for the auditor than refusal
citation: W. A. Kaal, ed., Agent Failure Mode Registry version 1.0, AFMR-F021 Mutual Audit Capture. https://wulfkaal.github.io/afmr/AFMR-F021
